scenario_description:
Objective: Keep LM-4627’s compact appointment-reminder cards from entering Thursday’s pilot with a preventable Tagalog display problem.
Emerging Need: Routine copy-freeze planning becomes risky when small-screen rendering shows a locale-specific call-to-action truncation before the export lock.
Decision Context: Early scope and schedule notices do not justify interrupting review capacity; later QA evidence and cutoff timing make a short internal language check feasible if the right reviewer window is known.
Consequence: If no risk note is prepared before the export snapshot, pilot users may see a clipped Tagalog action label and the issue shifts to post-pilot correction.

parameter.title: LM-4627 compact card copy freeze
parameter.description: Lock translated compact appointment-reminder cards for the Cascadia Care portal pilot export.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 compact appointment cards included in Thursday pilot
parameter.body: Cascadia is including the Spanish and Tagalog compact appointment-reminder cards in Thursday morning's patient-portal pilot. The copy package can follow the normal Wednesday noon export unless Luminara flags a language risk before then.

parameter.content: Pseudo-loc check on the compact cards: Spanish fits, but the Tagalog CTA for rescheduling wraps on the 320px card and engineering clips after the first line. Workflow will accept de-identified language risk notes until 11:30 Wednesday before the export locks.

parameter.title: LM-4627 compact card risk-note cutoff
parameter.content: Only de-identified compact-card text notes can be attached before the 11:30 export cutoff; after that, reviewer comments will not travel with the pilot package.

parameter.subject: LM-4627 compact card export snapshot sealed
parameter.body: The compact appointment-reminder card export snapshot sealed at 11:30 Pacific. No additional linguistic risk notes or reviewer comments can be attached to the Thursday pilot package through this workflow.
